text:
Maya R: Heads-up — NebulaOps is greenlit to request onboarding for Mediterranean-1 (med1). They want marketplace entitlement + a dedicated GPU pool. Target launch in ~3 weeks. Need approvals: marketplace listing, quota/entitlement, Redwood-managed KMS (HSM), and legal T&C signoff.

Dan K: can you drop the initial quota numbers + the SKU name and partner POC? I'll start the entitlement path once we have exacts.

Maya R: sure, posting numbers below. Partner POC: Esteban (cc).
```
Requested quotas (med1):
- GPU: 12 x A100-80GB (dedicated pool, preference for pinned hosts)
- vCPU: 512
- RAM: 3TB
- Block storage: 50TB
- Public IPs: 8 reserved
Marketplace SKU: nebulaops.med1.dedicated
Entitlement token: partner-onboard-v1
Initial soft-qa: 2 x A100 for smoke tests
```

Esteban (NebulaOps): Confirmed. Region is colocated with our partner DC in Barcelona — network egress estimate ~6TB/mo for launch, could grow. SLA: 99.9% with 4hr RTO for critical incidents. We can supply a smoke-test container and a small test dataset.

Liam S: Quick infra Qs — who will manage KMS? Redwood-managed HSM or partner-managed keys? Also, need the colocator point-of-presence and ASN for peering.

Maya R: Partner requested Redwood-managed KMS with HSM backing. They want us to hold keys for tenant-infra (no customer-supplied keys). I'll attach our private-deploy playbook link in the thread. Peering info to follow from Esteban.

Sophie T: Legal — please send a short data flow and confirm whether any PII or regulated data will be processed in med1. Also need to review NebulaOps' MSA redlines; if no PII, I can fast-track a clause set.

Esteban (NebulaOps): No PII expected. Only inference traffic and ephemeral logs (no request payload retention). We can sign the standard addendum. PX: Esteban@nebulaops.com

Raj P: I'll draft the marketplace listing (README, icons, entitlements). Need final SKU string from you (Maya) and any special pricing tiers for dedicated pools. Also +1 on starting with the 2x A100 soft quota for integration tests.

Maya R: Added owners and a short checklist:
- Quota/entitlement: Dan K
- Infra prep (KMS, routing, IPs): Liam S
- Legal T&Cs: Sophie T
- Marketplace listing: Raj P
- Partner POC / smoke tests: Esteban

partners-bot: Jira ticket created — INC-8921: "nebulaops med1 marketplace + quota onboarding" — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-8921

Dan K: On the quota path: I'll open the entitlement request with the cloud partner today. ETA: initial soft quota (2x A100) ~48h, full quota (12x A100) once legal signoff is in place (~7 business days after). I'll post updates in the ticket.

Esteban (NebulaOps): We can run a smoke test on Wednesday. I'll upload the container and the test script to the Jira ticket.

Liam S: Noted. I'll reserve the IPs and draft the routing patch. Also, ping me when the KMS grant form is ready for me to ingest.

Sophie T: I'll review the MSA addendum and the data flow. Expect signoff (or redlines) within 48h.

Maya R: Perfect — thanks all. I'll follow up after Sophie confirms and Dan posts initial quota. :white_check_mark:

Raj P: I'll open the marketplace PR once I get SKU + teaser copy from Maya.

Esteban (NebulaOps): Thanks — Esteban will be available for the smoke test and to share peering ASNs later today.

Maya R: Closing loop: next steps in Jira INC-8921. Please add any blockers there.

Liam S: 👍 will add required infra tickets under the same epic.

Dan K: moving to action.
